name: Gorillaz; Amiliorated Harvest
source:
2D, the singer of the famous British band Gorillaz, wakes up one morning only to find multiple corpses in Kong's basement. Each of their faces completely ripped off. Noodle: the Super-Soldier guitarist of the band, managed to escape through her bedroom window, not wanting to get involved in the case, while the other two members Russel and Murdoc appear to be more fixated on where the band will go after splitting up. Will 2D choose the Hell's Feel path and join Fouroboros? Or will he choose the Spectre Reaping path and join D2?

https://amelioratedharvest.straw.page/
